# Learn, Vibe, Build

> ATLS 4519, a CU Boulder studio course about becoming a builder with AI (Fall 2026, Mondays 5:05–7:35 PM, instructor Aaron Neyer). Students make something every week, write about it in their own words, and share it. Canvas is the official home for submissions and grades.

## Lessons

- [Week 1 — Orientation: Learn, Vibe, Build](https://cu.learnvibe.build/lessons/week-1/lesson.md): What this course is, the three C's (cognition, communication, creativity), the weekly rhythm, and the first shared practice.
- [Week 2 — Build night](https://cu.learnvibe.build/lessons/week-2/lesson.md): Tool tour, then building together in class: pick one tool, set it up, prove it works.
- [Week 3 — Everyone demos, then the tools](https://cu.learnvibe.build/lessons/week-3/lesson.md): Everyone shows what they built; then the AI tool landscape and how to choose.
- [Week 6: Learn With Your AI](https://cu.learnvibe.build/lessons/week-6/lesson.md): Use your AI to learn about AI, give it helpful context, then build something that supports your learning journey.

## Course

- [Syllabus](https://cu.learnvibe.build/SYLLABUS_DRAFT.md): course description, rhythm, grading, policies
- [Schedule](https://cu.learnvibe.build/schedule/): every week, what it covers, slides and lessons
- [Setup](https://cu.learnvibe.build/setup/): accounts, one tool, one proof
- [Tools](https://cu.learnvibe.build/studio/tools.html): the AI tools the class uses, with costs

## Learn with your AI
Copy any lesson markdown into your AI and ask it to teach you, then quiz you.
